name: sereinflow-ai-toolkit
description: Codex integration for safely discovering and operating live SereinFlow projects, flows, runs, SereinLang, and library packages through the SereinFlow MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the authenticated SereinFlow MCP API. Discover current server guidance, tools, resources, templates, and prompts before inspecting or changing projects, flows, runs, SereinLang, and library packages.
defaultPrompt: Use SereinFlow to inspect the current projects, flows, and run state.
Use SereinFlow to create or update a flow after loading the live operating guide.
Use SereinFlow to compile SereinLang and report the diagnostics.
